stories.headline: Nvidia Faces Leadership Shakeup After Jensen Huang's Abrupt Exit
stories.summary: Nvidia is navigating a succession crisis following Jensen Huang's abrupt departure as CEO, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. Bloomberg coverage frames the shakeup as having national-security implications given Nvidia's central role in the AI chip supply chain, and notes Huang has become a subject of internet memes rather than the AI advocate he once was.

stories.headline: Corporate Bonds' 6% Yields Draw Investors Seeking Shelter After Nvidia Turmoil
stories.summary: US corporate bonds have rallied in recent weeks as money managers seek shelter from stock-market turbulence tied to the Nvidia leadership drama, with yields around 6% drawing fresh demand. The move underscores a rotation toward credit as equity volatility, centered on AI-chip names, rattles markets.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Selloff Grinds Lower, Testing Crypto Investors' Resolve
stories.summary: Bitcoin's slow-motion selloff is pushing prices toward their lowest levels of the year as major sources of demand weaken, leaving even committed traders weary. Bloomberg describes a succession of setbacks eroding confidence in the crypto market's near-term recovery.

stories.headline: SpaceX's S&P 500 Ambitions Revived via Possible Tesla Merger
stories.summary: Months after being denied swift entry into the S&P 500, Elon Musk may be pursuing a backdoor route for SpaceX by pitching a merger with Tesla. The move would reshape Tesla's structure and could reignite questions about index eligibility for Musk's ventures.

stories.headline: State Street, Pictet Call Time on Europe's Stock Market Rally
stories.summary: European equities have recently outperformed other global markets, but strategists at State Street and Pictet now expect that outperformance streak to end soon. The call suggests investors should prepare for a rotation away from European stocks relative to peers.

stories.headline: Fed's Collins Backs 'Steady, Gradual' Rate Hikes
stories.summary: Boston Fed President Susan Collins said a gradual path of interest-rate increases remains appropriate to bring down inflation. Her comments signal continued hawkish leanings among some Fed officials even as markets watch for shifts in the policy path.

stories.headline: India Stock Market Rebounds as Global AI Trade Unwinds
stories.summary: Indian equities are rebounding as the broader global AI investment trade reverses and foreign funds return to the market. The shift suggests capital is rotating out of AI-heavy developed markets and back into emerging markets like India.

stories.headline: Italy Fines Meta €805 Million Over Unauthorized Access to Users' Photos
stories.summary: Italian regulators penalized Meta roughly €805 million for accessing Android users' photo galleries without explicit consent. The fine adds to Meta's growing list of European regulatory and privacy liabilities.
